name: ui-table-view
description: TableView — sortable, selectable data table rendering rows over configurable columns, with inline row actions and grouping. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui table-view pattern).

schema.name: ui-table-view
schema.description: TableView — sortable, selectable data table rendering rows over configurable columns, with inline row actions and grouping. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui table-view pattern).

events.name: Table view loaded
events.description: TableView rows finished loading; payload.data holds the collection.

events.name: @config.select event
events.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { selectedIds }.

events.name: @config.sort event
events.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.

events.name: View
events.description: User opened a record from the list.

look.label: Look
look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the data-list / entity-table look enum so authors share one knob name across row renderers.

sortEvent.label: Sort Event
sortEvent.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.

dndItemIdField.label: Dnd Item Id Field
dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

className.label: Class Name
className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the table root.

dndRoot.label: Dnd Root
dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

dropEvent.label: Drop Event
dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

dragGroup.label: Drag Group
dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Max rows before a 'Show More' button. Defaults to 0 (show all).

reorderEvent.label: Reorder Event
reorderEvent.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

accepts.label: Accepts
accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

groupBy.label: Group By
groupBy.description: Group rows under section headers by a field value.

selectEvent.label: Select Event
selectEvent.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { selectedIds }.

selectable.label: Selectable
selectable.description: Render a leading checkbox column. Selection changes emit `selectEvent`.

selfFetch.label: Fetch its own rows on mount?
selfFetch.description: true (default) = standalone mount self-populates on INIT. false = a composing atom owns the fetch and routes its loaded event here — suppresses the wrapper's own un-hydrated fetch so it cannot race the composer's.

sortColumn.label: Sort Column
sortColumn.description: Current sort column (display hint for the active header arrow).

itemClickEvent.label: Item Click Event
itemClickEvent.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract. When OMITTED and `itemActions` exist, the row click defaults to the first non-danger item action (the view/open action by authoring convention) — a danger action never becomes the row default (destructive actions require intentional reach).

sortable.label: Sortable
sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

itemActions.label: Item Actions
itemActions.description: Per-row actions, collected under a trailing kebab overflow menu.

emptyMessage.label: Empty Message
emptyMessage.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

positionEvent.label: Position Event
positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

selectedIds.label: Selected Ids
selectedIds.description: Currently-selected ids (controlled). Falls back to local state when omitted.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Column definitions. The compiler emits `columns`; `fields` is the alias.
